items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: Like when we have a big band like Buddy Johnson and that.

ctx.x: Really? That big? That's fabulous. That's a fabulous big place.

Yeah, it was two, you see. We had a, when we had a small dance, we cut one part off. Yeah, I see. Like when we have a big band like Buddy Johnson and that. Yeah. We take that out and you got to, that's a whole block. Yeah. From Sinan to Orleans. Really? Mm-hmm.
Oh, that's great. Yeah. That's really great.
